title: Live bar pull proof: prove every decided Track 1 slot observed real data

checkpoint and book carry 00:55 from the live NKD close
data_observation/ does not exist yet - the first slot creates it

answers.2_where_evidence_is_written: global_index/track1_runtime/data_observation/data_observation_YYYYMMDD.jsonl (append-only, dated, beside the other evidence streams)

3_every_future_decided_slot_requires_pro.scope: once the stream exists for that day
3_every_future_decided_slot_requires_pro.justification: the ledger row already proves the slot ran and decided; the observation row proves what it observed. A missing observation WEAKENS the evidence without contradicting it. Making it fatal would fail every window recorded before this stage existed - not a finding about those windows. It stops being tolerable the day a paper order is sent on a decision nobody can show the data for, and the readiness gate is where that belongs.

4_what_is_proven_per_instrument: provider (as the join reported it, not a guess)
three identities kept apart: runner name / history symbol / order symbol
parquet path and <path>:<sha256> identity - the same shape the explanation row carries
splice_result (the code the join produced), notices, detail, dropped_columns
dropped_open_final_bar: NULL with a reason - see the residual

5_changes_strategy_decisions.why: every number already existed on the objects the slot built while deciding; the writer reads them and computes nothing
asserted: imports nothing named signal / detector / sleeve / params (AST)
instrument_row calls as_dict and no aggregation function (AST)
the row is written AFTER the ledger row (AST line numbers)
the write is wrapped so it cannot take a slot down (AST)

6_old_slots_without_observation.principle: a day with no stream at all is a fact about the SOFTWARE, not about the window - classified, never accused

7_dashboard.placement: one line inside the EXISTING Operational block - not a new section
7_dashboard.why: the panel already has a health block and a signal chip; a third heading for a single sentence costs more attention than it returns
three_shapes: Data: IBKR · NKD · 1186 live bars checked · last 02:55 ET · splice OK
Data proof: not recorded by this slot version
asserted: no variable names, no JSON, no thresholds
a length cap so it cannot wrap to three lines on a phone
exactly one Data line per job

10_remaining_before_paper.class: time - and --verify-strict is NOW LIVE, so the 16:20 job will record one

10_remaining_before_paper.item: broker stop proof, partial fills, order in flight across a restart

the_gap.window: global_nkd 2026-08-26 - PASS, 22 slots, all decided, no candidates, p95 32.2s
the_gap.statement: the ledger proved the slot DECIDED; nothing proved WHAT IT LOOKED AT. On a route that has never traded, a slot that fetched nothing and one that fetched a thousand bars produce the same ledger row.
the_gap.already_proven_and_not_re_solved: data_source_identity on that same row carries <parquet path>:<sha256> - the HISTORY side was provable; the LIVE side was not

the_residual_named_rather_than_guessed.explanation: nothing in the chain records whether the provider's final bar was still forming when it was handed over. The fetch is causal - it keeps bars at or before the instant it was taken - but that is a different guarantee.
the_residual_named_rather_than_guessed.closing_it: means asking the provider layer a question it does not currently answer - a small stage, not a blocker

three_write_cases.refused before deciding: a refusal row naming the code - 'nobody looked' and 'we looked and were refused' call for different actions
three_write_cases.never reached either: NOTHING - a row claiming an observation nobody made is worse than no row

no_bar_arrays.rule: no raw bar array, no prices
no_bar_arrays.why: a row that embedded bars would grow with the market and would put price data into a stream whose purpose is provenance
no_bar_arrays.enforced_by: a test that walks the whole payload and fails on any list longer than 20 items or any non-scalar leaf, plus a 4 KB cap on one row

operator_restart_i_did_not_do.why_i_checked: a process table that disagrees with what I did is a reason to stop
restart_was_clean: THE SEVEN PRE-FLIGHT DAYS RESTORED - the operator's repair survived

settles_liveness_in_the_opposite_directi.conclusion: the new processes picked up EVERYTHING

verified_against_the_live_api.5ZO data line on a job: 'Data proof: not recorded by this slot version'

operator_restart_i_did_not_do.slot_writer_needs_no_restart: slots run as fresh subprocesses, so the first Track 1 window after this produces real observation rows

three_worth_naming: the END-TO-END WIRING test - a `root` parameter was added to the slot writer purely so one could exist, because a mechanism nobody has watched run is a trap this project has already paid for twice
the ORDERING test - reads line numbers out of the AST to prove the observation row is written after the ledger row
the PAYLOAD WALK - fails on any list long enough to be bar data rather than trusting a sentence that says there is none

claims_deliberately_NOT_made: that the provider's final bar was or was not open
